note: All facts read directly from AscendNPU-IR at HEAD 90037fe3371cb88d50c42cd4e165075cbafe83b1 (branch master). No compiler was executed in this analysis; test files are cited as FileCheck expectations recorded at HEAD, not as observed runs.

records.statement: Pass identity: def EnableStrideAlign : Pass<"hivm-enable-stride-align", "ModuleOp">, summary 'Align memref allocations according to stride align marks', description 'Re-allocate memrefs according to anntations of storage_align marks. ModuleOp scope is required so FuncOp-parallel nesting cannot race when aligned allocs propagate through func.call into VF callees.'; constructor mlir::hivm::createEnableStrideAlignPass(); dependentDialects: memref, annotation, arith.

alignStoragePipeline composition (HIVMRegbasePipelines.cpp 485-494): (1) createAlignAllocSizePass() on the module; (2) if hivmPipelineOptions.enableHIVMAutoStorageAlign, FuncOp-nested createPreMarkStrideAlignPass() then createMarkStrideAlignPass(); (3) FuncOp-nested memref::createFoldAllocReshapePass() — not gated; (4) createEnableStrideAlignPass() on the module — not gated. Only the two marking passes are inside the enableHIVMAutoStorageAlign gate.

Placement: hivmPostBufferizationOptimizationPipeline (defined at 514) calls alignStoragePipeline at line 560, after the HIVMAggregatedDecomposeOp run with DecomposePhase AFTER_RECOGNIZE_BROADCAST and before the AFTER_HIVM_STRIDE_ALIGNMENT decompose run, ADD_CANONICALIZER, createInferHIVMDataLayoutPass ('convert copyOp to nd2nzOp') and the buffer-size passes (createAutoInferBufferSizePass / createConstantizeBufferSizePass, 562-580). hivmPostBufferizationOptimizationPipeline is itself called from buildLowerHIVMPipelines at line 699, immediately after bufferizationPipeline.

Mark format consumed: annotation.mark ops carrying DenseI32ArrayAttr pair 'hivm.stride_align_dims' + 'hivm.stride_align_value_in_byte' (e.g. {hivm.stride_align_dims = array<i32: 0>, hivm.stride_align_value_in_byte = array<i32: 32>} on #hivm.address_space<ub> memrefs), seen throughout the tests. Producer MarkStrideAlign (hivm-mark-stride-align, func::FuncOp scope, summary 'For all hivm ops, annotate their memref operands with storage_align marks automatically', Passes.td 876-886) creates marks via markAlignedDim with value = util::getHWAlignBytes(memory space), and errors on tensor (not bufferized), unranked, or non-strided-layout memrefs.

PreMarkStrideAlign (hivm-pre-mark-stride-align, func::FuncOp scope, Passes.td 860-874) returns immediately when the target is not regbase; on regbase it walks hivm::LoadOp results that flow to a vload inside a VF, traces each to its root, and calls markSkipStrideAlignForVLoad (PreMarkStrideAlign.cpp 159-197). Its marks are consumed upstream of this pass's marks (protection decision made by the marking side, not by EnableStrideAlign).

runOnOperation (EnableStrideAlign.cpp 738-809): sets thread_local archIsRegbased = hacc::utils::isRegBasedArch(module) and archIs950 = hacc::utils::isAscend950(module); walks func::FuncOps sequentially (comment: 'EnableAlignAllocation may update VF callees via propagateFuncCallOp; nesting under parallel FuncOp adaptors races'), skipping host funcs; sets isMarkStrideForAiv if any hivm::FixpipeOp exists; per func: propagteAlignInfoUpToAlloc(enableNormalize=true) → if archIs950 && isMarkStrideForAiv, AddStrideAlignInfoForAiv(module) → propagateAlignInfoToOperands (fixed point) → applyPatterns<RemoveAlignMarkPattern> → EnableAlignAllocation<memref::AllocOp, memref::AllocaOp> greedy → handlePropagateFailure(rewriter, funcOp) → if archIsRegbased, materializeRemainingStaticUBLayoutCasts → if !archIsRegbased, set hivm::StorageAlignedAttr on the func (comment: 'Master metadata contract, membase only: regbase (A5) targets must not carry this attribute.'); any per-func failure interrupts the walk and signalPassFailure() is called.

NormalizeAlignInfoPattern (EnableStrideAlign.cpp 58-108), applied first via propagteAlignInfoUpToAlloc(enableNormalize=true): for marks carrying the stride-align attrs it emitErrors when dims or bytes are missing ('align info must contain align dims and align bytes') or sizes differ ('size of align bytes should be matched with size of align dims'), otherwise sorts the (dim,byte) pairs ascending via sortAlignInfo (no-op failure when already sorted); a 'TODO: merge same dimension setting' comment records that duplicate dims are not merged here.

Up-propagation to root allocations: populatePropagateAlignUpToRootAllocationPattern (PropagateAlignUtil.cpp 1714-1719) registers PropagateAlignUpToRootAllocationPattern (1934-1975), which reads the attrs off a mark and dispatches on the marked value's defining op: memref.cast/subview/view/collapse_shape/expand_shape/reshape/hivm.bitcast, scf.for result or iter arg, scf.if result; the alloc case sets/unions the attrs directly on the alloc op (propagateAlignUp default case, 790-836, and processYieldOp additionally only when NOT regbase, 826-830). Legality errors: 'Cannot align <value> across blocks.' for block args not owned by an scf.for (1944-1947) and 'Cannot align unranked memref' (1948-1949); mismatched mark attrs emitError 'Mismatched storage align marks' (1941-1942). The consumed mark's attrs are removed and the mark erased when attr-empty (1965-1973).

Down-propagation to leaf operands: PropagateAlignDownToLeafOperandsPattern (PropagateAlignUtil.cpp 1977-1991) copies a marked value's demands to its users: memref.cast (295), memref.subview with dim remapping over dropped dims (300-330), memref.collapse_shape/expand_shape/reshape via reassociation mapping (332-401), hivm.bitcast (403-422), scf.for init (marks the loop result and the region iter arg, 424-453), scf.if yield (creates or LCM-unions the mark on the if-result, 455-504). scf.yield propagation is explicitly skipped on regbase: 'if (hacc::utils::isRegBasedArch(...)) return failure();' (559-566). Demand mapping through reassociations can fail with 'cannot align <dim> axis for <value>' (204-207, 256-258); collapse borrowing across dims is gated on an identity-layout (contiguous) source (123-152).

Union across op operands: populatePropagateAlignAmongOpOperandsPatterns registers PropagateAlignAmongOperationOperands over all ops in HIVMVectorOps.cpp.inc plus hivm::CopyOp (EnableStrideAlign.cpp 469-481). The pattern only handles hivm::HIVMStructuredOp, skips hivm::LoadOp/hivm::StoreOp ('no need to do stride align for gm', 280-284), and collects TargetSpaceOperands(UB, no temp buffer) that are ranked memrefs (286-299). processAlignPropagationAmongOperationOperands (216-267) unions the marks of all marked operands (unionAlignInfo takes std::lcm of the byte values when the same dim appears in two marks, PropagateAlignUtil.cpp 1757-1763), then re-marks each unmarked or under-aligned operand (markAlignInfoForNoAlignOperand 163-181 / markAlignInfoForAlignedOperand 183-214); for CopyOp operand 0 (the source) is skipped (248-253) — the no-backprop behavior regression-tested by stride-align-copy-src-no-backprop.mlir ('Regression test for EnableStrideAlign's copy-back alignment over-propagation', test lines 3-9).

Fixed-point demand exchange: propagateAlignInfoToOperands (EnableStrideAlign.cpp 591-634) collects the align-info map of all alloc-like ops with stride-align attrs (collectAlignInfo 514-534), then loops { propagateDownAlignInfo (AddAlignAnnotationMarkForAlloc + PropagateAlignDownToLeafOperandsPattern, 563-574) → populatePropagateAlignAmongOpOperands (greedy with config.maxIterations = 10000, 576-589) → propagteAlignInfoUpToAlloc } until the alloc align-info map is unchanged, with maxIterations = 10; non-convergence emits 'propagate storage align failure and match the max iterations' and returns failure. AddAlignAnnotationMarkForAlloc (131-161) re-creates a mark from attrs already sitting on an alloc, skipping all-1-shaped memrefs.

The allocation rewrite: EnableAlignAllocation<AllocLikeOp> (EnableStrideAlign.cpp 359-445) requires the stride-align attrs on the alloc op; alignUnits = utils::collectAlignUnits<MemRefType>(alignDims, alignBytes, type, archIsRegbased) (372-377); calculateAlignedShape appends a trailing 1 dim and ceil-aligns each padded dim (PropagateAlignUtil.cpp 1810-1824; AlignUpOFR emits arith addi/remsi/subi for dynamic dims, 1792-1808). If alignedShape differs from the original: a new alloc with the padded static shape and cleared layout is created (403-411); scaleBufferSizeMarks rescales every buffer_size_in_byte mark on the buffer by the static-volume ratio using ceil division ('ceil-divide so the buffer is never under-allocated', 322-357); a rank-reduced memref.subview with offsets 0, sizes = original shape (+ trailing 1), strides 1 recovers the logical view (418-426); replaceAndPropagateMemRefType rewires all users and the old alloc is erased (427-432). If shapes already match: no rewrite, both attrs are removed from the alloc ('no need to do alignment', 433-441).

Arch-dependent pad-dim mapping and units: utils::collectAlignUnits (Dialect/Utils/Util.h 571-613) computes alignTargets[dim] = lcm(alignBits / elementBitWidth) elements per marked dim, skips a mark whose alignBytes*8 divides the element bit width ('If the alignment is smaller than type size, align to itself'), and asserts 'Alignment cannot satisfied by bitwidth' when alignBits is not a multiple of the element bit width. The default path (membase, or non-unit-stride last dim) calls setAlignUnits(..., dim, dim+1): the pad dim is the marked dim's NEXT dim — KernelInfo.cpp 362-366 states: 'the input to collectAlignUnits is the axis to which the stride should be aligned. The stride is aligned by aligning the **next** dimension.' The regbase path (isRegBasedArch && isLastMemrefDimUnitStride) calls setAlignUnits(..., dim, dim): the marked dim itself is padded, requiring a unit-stride last dim. alignUnits[0] = 1 (outermost dim never padded). setAlignUnits (Dialect/Utils/Util.cpp 204-227) LCM-accumulates the inner shape product, so one padded dim can satisfy several marks, and skips dynamic dims when accumulating.

Type propagation and copy fallback: replaceAndPropagateMemRefType (PropagateAlignUtil.cpp 1835-1932, doc-comment 1826-1834: 'memref.view cannot be aligned, because it assumes empty layout') wraps the new value in an unrealized_conversion_cast and pushes it down through subview, collapse_shape/expand_shape (guarded by isGuaranteedCollapsibleUnStrictly for non-identity layouts, 888-891), reshape, cast, hivm.bitcast, scf.for (retypes init/iter-arg/result and re-wraps them, 1008-1051), scf.if yield (1150-1190), scope.return (retypes the scope result, 1214-1243), func.call (retypes callee signature and args, 1295-1382), and a default case that refuses memref-producing users or regions with memref block args (1265-1292). Un-propagatable cases are tagged with attr 'PropagateFailure' (propagateFailureName, AlignBuffer/Util.h 31-34; tagging at 1910-1916). handlePropagateFailure (1618-1666) later replaces each tagged use with a fresh empty buffer + hivm.hir.copy and inserts dominator-ordered copies around writes on both sides (findWriteOp 1540-1616, which also matches TCB-id Fixpipe/SyncBlockSet/SyncBlockWait pairs). scf.while is unsupported: propagateYieldOp returns failure for WhileOp with 'TODO: need to support whileOp better in strideAlign case' (1204-1207).

Demand filtering during propagation: adjustAlignInfo (AdjustAlignUtil.cpp 565-600) drops demands whose dim maps to nothing (adjustAlignDim returns nullopt) and LCM-merges duplicate dims, then sorts. adjustAlignDim (509-547) drops the demand via isNoNeedAlign (GM memory space 'no need to storage align for gm', all-1 dims before the align dim, or isAlreadyAligned — existing stride * elemBits % hwAlignBits == 0, 47-80), drops it for ops that will lower to scalar loops ('no need to stride align because it will be decomposed to scalar operation later'), drops it for LoadOp/StoreOp with MayImplicitTransposeWithLastAxis, and otherwise adjusts per-op semantics (VBrc, VReduce, VDeinterleave, Copy, inline-broadcastable HIVM ops via the flatten interface).

Membase expected outcome (FileCheck expectations, not executed): hivm-enable-storage-align.mlir runs 'bishengir-opt -hivm-enable-stride-align -split-input-file'; its first function has no hacc.target ('defaults to 910B (membase)') and expects 'func.func @test_elementwise_unary_op_unaligned(...) hivm.storage_aligned'; a marked memref<2x15xf16, ub> (dims [0], 32 bytes) becomes memref.alloc() : memref<2x16x1xf16, ub> plus memref.subview [0,0,0][2,15,1][1,1,1]; dynamic dims get arith addi/remsi/subi ceil-align arithmetic; 'CHECK-NOT: annotation.mark'. In the already-aligned function (16 f16 elements = 32B), allocs keep their exact type with 'CHECK-NOT: memref.subview' — no rewrite at all. A marked 4096x4xf32 UB buffer (dims [0], 32B) becomes memref<4096x8x1xf32> with subview result type strided<[8, 1]>.

RegBase expected outcome (FileCheck expectations, not executed): hivm-enable-stride-align-late-vf-cleanup.mlir (module attrs hacc.target = Ascend950PR_9579, hivm.module_core_type AIV) marks dim 2 of a 5x8x7xf16 UB buffer (32B) and expects the outlined VF's argument to become memref<5x8x7xf16, strided<[128, 16, 1]>, ub> — shape unchanged, row stride padded 7→16 elements — with the aligned layout carried through subview + expand_shape into the already-visited callee and 'CHECK-NOT: unrealized_conversion_cast'. hivm-enable-stride-align-median-kernel.mlir (a real median kernel of '43 outlined vector functions operating on strided subviews of UB memrefs') expects strided<[256, 128, 64, 32, 16, 1]> argument types and states the pass 'only guards against crashes / silent skips' and that 'hivm.storage_aligned ... on this Ascend950 (regbase) target it must NOT be stamped'. bishenghivm-enable-stride-align-propagate-scope.mlir expects a scope.scope result type updated to memref<2x15xf16, strided<[240, 16]>>.

Failure-path and edge-case expectations (FileCheck, not executed): hivm-enable-storage-align-propagate-failure.mlir shows an scf.if whose both branches yield allocs that cannot be uniformly retyped — expected result keeps the if yield at memref<32x259xf16, strided<[4144, 16]>> with 'CHECK-NOT: hivm.hir.copy' in the first case, and materializes 'hivm.hir.copy' in the scalar-result-type case. enable-stride-align-rank-reducing-subview.mlir is a regression test where getDroppedDims 'must fall back to position-based matching instead of asserting when stride-based matching cannot identify a unique dropped dim'.

Metadata contract and option: HIVM_StorageAligned ('hivm.storage_aligned') is defined as: 'If a module is tagged with this attribute, it means that all of the operations within all device functions in this module are aligned. If a function is tagged with this attribute, it means that all of the operations in this function are aligned.' (HIVMAttrs.td 1122-1129). The pipeline option EnableHIVMAutoStorageAlign ('Enable mark/enable storage align.') is a bool defaulting to 'true' (Options.td 630-633); a repo-wide grep of bishengir/lib found the attr being set only in EnableStrideAlign.cpp — no in-repo reader of the attr was found at HEAD.

Recent history of the membase-only stamping: commit a82e34730 '[AscendNPU-IR] Gate hivm.storage_aligned stamping to membase targets' touches EnableStrideAlign.cpp and is the most recent commit in its history at HEAD (followed by 5e77638a8 'fix: UCC build error' and 81facaeed 'fix: backpropagation in EnableStrideAlign cause error stride').
